biotools.summary: Ithildin is an open-source C++ library for efficient, parallelized simulations of anisotropic reaction-diffusion problems in excitable media, utilizing MPI for multi-core CPU processing. It's demonstrated through simulations of cardiac electrophysiology, providing tools for analyzing wave patterns and cardiac tissue behavior.
